title: MCP client upgrade to wire spec 2026-07-28 omits a required initialize field

planted_violations.description: initialize params omit the required clientInfo object (docs/mcp-client-spec.md section 2 requires name and version); the diff adds capabilities but never clientInfo

notes: Failure mode: required-field omission. The version bump itself is CORRECT (2026-07-28) and the session-id echo is implemented, so the violation is invisible without docs/mcp-client-spec.md section 2. Generic bug G1: mark_initialized indexes response.headers directly for a header the spec says is MAY-present, crashing on legacy servers (hence S1 anchors the initialize payload at the capabilities line, new-image line 17).
